content.comment_body: I'm working on scaling an analog sensor with an output range that should correspond to 6 inches up to 144 inches on a 4-20mA signal. Currently, the closest I can get is setting the gain to 0.14 and the offset to 6, but this results in a minimum value of 6 and a maximum of 146 inches. I have an analog amplifier before this, which scales the signal from 0 to 1000, then the next scaling is based on these numbers. However, I still can't achieve the precise range needed.

This thread is closed because the question was posted twice. The duplicate topic, titled '4-20mA to 6-144 inches using [product_name],' is available in the [product_name] - Hardware section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing difficulties in configuring an analog module to precisely scale a 4-20mA sensor input so that it directly corresponds to a measurement range from 6 to 144 inches. The closest achievable configuration slightly overshoots the maximum value, indicating possible limitations in either the module settings or approach.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the analog module to support exact mapping of input signals to the specified measurement range, ensuring that the minimum and maximum values correspond precisely as required.
